Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrite positivity, and elevated urine glucose, with E. coli >100,000 CFU/mL, indicating a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and low specific gravity are noted. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and prompt antimicrobial therapy; consider evaluation for possible underlying diabetes due to glucosuria.
